title: Light
errNoCurl: curl was not found. Install it (the zesis NixOS module's batteriesIncluded ships it).
errNoCredentials: No Tapo login found. Put TAPO_USER=..., TAPO_PASS=... and TAPO_HOSTS=<bulb IP> in ~/.config/zesis/tapo.env (chmod 600).
errNoKeyring: No keyring is available. Put TAPO_USER=... and TAPO_PASS=... in ~/.config/zesis/tapo.env (chmod 600).
errAuth: The light refused the login. Check TAPO_USER/TAPO_PASS and turn on Third-Party Compatibility in the Tapo app.
errNetwork: Can't reach the light at %1, retrying.
